|} == Description ==
__TOC__
{{ Skill progression max12
| title track =
| varN name =
| varN at0  =
| varN at12 =
}}
This template is used to generate a skill progression table '''for skills linked to a title track whose max rank is 12'''. You should use this template for : * [[:Category:Allegiance rank skills|Luxon / Kurzick skills]] Do not use this template for : * [[:Category:Sunspear rank skills|Sunspear skills]] * [[:Category:Norn rank skills|Norn skills]] * [[:Category:Deldrimor rank skills|Deldrimor skills]] * [[:Category:Asura rank skills|Asura skills]] * [[:Category:Ebon Vanguard rank skills|Ebon Vanguard skills]] For general -attribute related- skills, use : [[Template:Skill progression]]. === Parameters === ; var''N'' name : The name of the variable ''N''. ; var''N'' at0 : The value of the variable ''N'' when your rank in the corresponding title track is 0. ; var''N'' at12 : The value of the variable ''N'' when your rank in the corresponding title track is 12 (max). Where ''N'' is a number between 1 and 6. (At least one variable has to be set) == Example == 
{{ Skill progression max12
| title track = [[Allegiance rank]]
| var1 name = [[Damage]] 
| var1 at0 = 20
| var1 at12 = 40
| var2 name = [[Adrenaline]]
| var2 at0 = 2
| var2 at12 = 4
}}
{{ Skill progression max12 | title track = [[Allegiance rank]] | var1 name = [[Damage]] | var1 at0 = 20 | var1 at12 = 40 | var2 name = [[Adrenaline]] | var2 at0 = 2 | var2 at12 = 4 }} == See also == * [[Template:Skill progression max12 old]] * [[Template:Skill progression]] * [[Template:Skill infobox]] * [[Template:Skill progression limit]] (is needed for this template) [[Category:Skill templates|Skill progression]]
